note: SCG I.13 [15]: an instrumental mover cannot move unless there is a principal mover. That bears on this premise without stating it: the premise says that a mover that does not move by its own form moves only as moved (a per se link), not that a principal mover exists. The closer sentence, ST I q.18 a.3 co. (instrumentum, quod non agit ex virtute suae formae, sed ex virtute principalis agentis), was read in the pinned AQUINAS-ST-I-Q18-A3 passage but has no claim record; a claim on it would source DEF-MOVES-BY-OWN-FORM.
